title_original: 철도물류산업의 육성 및 지원에 관한 법률 시행령
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Enforcement Decree of the Act on Appraisal and Appraisers) <Presidential Decree No. 32352, January 21, 2022>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on January 21, 2022.

Articles 2 through 4
Omitted.

Article 5 (Amendments to Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) through <56> Omitted.

<57> The Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Promotion and Support of the Railroad Logistics Industry shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 4 (2), "two appraisal business operators under Article 2, subparagraph 4 of the Act on Appraisal and Appraisers" shall be replaced with "two appraisal corporations, etc. under the Act on Appraisal and Appraisers."

<58> through <64> Omitted.
